verdict.rationale: Bird & Bird ships free-to-use interactive questionnaire tools (SCC Generator, German Term Sheet Generator) built on Contract Express that walk users step-by-step through producing real, executable legal documents, with Docusign integration for execution — this is genuine self-serve document assembly, not static templates. Missing for 10: broader range of document types beyond these two named tools, no independent/third-party corroboration of usability, and no evidence of founder-specific document suites beyond the VC term sheet generator.
